title: 중앙선거관리위원회 위원 수당 등에 관한 규칙 / queue:ARTICLE:1:0:00001:part:1/1
title_original: 중앙선거관리위원회 위원 수당 등에 관한 규칙
full_text: Article 1 (Purpose) The purpose of these Rules is to prescribe matters concerning expenses for activities to promote fair elections and allowances for reviewing agenda items paid to the Chairperson and non-standing members of the National Election Commission under Article 12 of the Election Commission Act, and matters necessary for implementing such payments. <Amended on February 6, 2024>
